test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A maximum of how money pieces of 34.6 cm can be cut from a 658 cm long rod?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the rod = 658 cm.

Length of each piece to be cut = 34.6 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Maximum number of pieces = Total length of the rod / Length of each piece

**Calculation:**

Maximum number of pieces = 658 / 34.6

⇒ Maximum number of pieces = (658)/(34.6)

⇒ Maximum number of pieces = 19

**The maximum number of pieces that can be cut from a 658 cm long rod is 19.**
